verdict.rationale: Chargebee documents dunning email reminders and smart retry logic for recovering failed payments, which supports part of the dunning-recovery workflow, but the evidence pack contains no explicit mention of network account updater, backup payment methods, or hosted update-payment pages. missing for 10: explicit documentation of network account updater (card auto-refresh via card networks), backup/secondary payment method fallback, and hosted payment page update flows for customers.
